description: Record the person's own answer about their own seat: yes, partly, or no, plus anything they said in their own words. 'partly' is a real answer and usually the most useful one -- do not round it to yes or no. Only ever call this with what they actually said; never infer an answer from tone or from what they said about something else.

note.description: Their own words, verbatim where possible

seat_external_id.description: The seat the question is about; must be one the caller holds

name: answer_coaching_question
